footnote_text: Received in exchange for 1,052,630 shares of Class A common stock of Avenzo Therapeutics, Inc. ("Legacy Avenzo") pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger and Reorganization, dated as of May 31, 2026, by and among Legacy Avenzo, Farmington Merger Sub, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of the Issuer ("Merger Sub") and the Issuer (the "Merger Agreement"). || Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, on November 20, 2026, Merger Sub merged with and into Legacy Avenzo (the "Merger"), with Legacy Avenzo surviving the Merger as a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Issuer. At the effective time of the Merger, each outstanding share of common stock and preferred stock of Legacy Avenzo, other than shares issued in the concurrent financing and other excluded shares under the Merger Agreement, was converted into the right to receive 0.2611 shares of common stock of the Issuer. Immediately prior to the closing of the Merger, the Issuer effected a reverse stock split at a ratio of one new share for every two shares of common stock of the Issuer. In connection with the Merger, the name of the Issuer was changed from Rallybio Corporation to Avenzo Therapeutics, Inc.

OrbiMed Capital GP IX LLC ("GP IX") is the general partner of OPI IX. OrbiMed Advisors LLC ("OrbiMed Advisors") is the managing member of GP IX.
